data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [Fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** An **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS INFANTRY** unit of yours, not a **KATAPHRON** unit, up to 8" from that enemy unit and outside [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of all enemy units.

**Effect:** The unit can move as far as D6" with a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move). If the unit has **HALO OVERRIDE**, it can move as far as 6" instead.
